newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close higher in broad trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close higher in broad trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed slightly higher on Tuesday with investors active among a wide range of shares, brokers said.

The all share index closed 2.82 points up at 644.70. Price gains led declines 27 to 11. Ceylon Grain Elevators rose 75 cents to 18.50 rupees, Ceylon Tobacco 75 cents to 36.25, Ceylon Brewery 1.50 to 47.50.

"More investors are looking at an increasing number of stocks after recent positive developments like the reserve ratio cut and the agreement between the government and opposition party," said Ajit Dias Wanigasekera, a trader at Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
